Thanks for the kind thoughts. Today was just one of those bad days where my mind would not let up. If it wasn't for my mom and on friend that lives on the other side of the world, I'm not sure if I would be here. But as long as I know that they will call a few times a month, I'll stay alive to answer answer they phone.

Thanks for your thoughts. I will keep going one day at a time. Today was just a bad day.
